brief: Go through this codebase and make all improvements that you can to the app

roles.title: UI Engineer
roles.mission: Convert all inline styles to Tailwind CSS classes, eliminating imperative hover handlers and style objects
roles.expertise: Tailwind CSS v4, CSS custom properties, React JSX styling patterns, design system consistency

roles.title: Reliability Engineer
roles.mission: Add error boundaries, standardize service error handling, and harden the application against failures
roles.expertise: React error boundaries, service layer patterns, defensive programming, user-facing error states

roles.title: Backend Engineer
roles.mission: Improve Supabase Edge Functions with better error handling, extracted constants, and proper HTTP status codes
roles.expertise: Deno runtime, Supabase Edge Functions, TypeScript, REST API design, error handling patterns

roles.title: Code Quality Engineer
roles.mission: Remove dead code, consolidate utilities, and improve library modules
roles.expertise: Code hygiene, dead code detection, utility consolidation, defensive initialization

tasks.title: Tailwind migration — pages
tasks.prompt: Convert all inline style={{}} objects to Tailwind CSS classes in the 3 page files. See envelope for full instructions.

tasks.title: Tailwind migration — components group A
tasks.prompt: Convert all inline style={{}} objects to Tailwind CSS classes in Layout, CommandPalette, AddPodcastModal, CreateKBModal, AddToKBModal. See envelope for full instructions.

tasks.title: Tailwind migration — components group B
tasks.prompt: Convert all inline style={{}} objects to Tailwind CSS classes in ChatPanel, InsightsPanel, ProcessingProgress, ProcessingLog, ui.jsx. See envelope for full instructions.

tasks.title: Error boundary + App.jsx hardening
tasks.prompt: Create an ErrorBoundary component and integrate it into App.jsx. See envelope for full instructions.

tasks.title: Service layer + lib hardening
tasks.prompt: Standardize error handling across all service files and improve lib modules. See envelope for full instructions.

tasks.title: Edge function improvements
tasks.prompt: Improve all edge functions with better error handling, constants, and status codes. See envelope for full instructions.

tasks.title: Dead code removal + utility consolidation
tasks.prompt: Remove dead code (PodcastCard.jsx) and consolidate utilities. See envelope for full instructions.
